references.text: Psalm 69:22 speaks of a punishment that is both specific and severe, similar to the seriousness of causing one of these little ones who believe to stumble.
In Isaiah 8:14-15, stumbling is mentioned, which can be seen as parallel to causing someone to sin or fall away.
Luke 17:1-2 contains a similar warning about causing little ones who believe to stumble and mentions a punishment like that in Matthew 18:6.
Mark 9:42 also gives a warning about the seriousness of causing one of these little ones who believe to stumble, with a similar description of the punishment.
